title: Capitolo 9 · The past with ESSERE — travel and arriving in Italy
shortDescription: The passato prossimo with essere and participle agreement (sono andato / andata / andati / andate), choosing avere or essere, reflexive verbs in the past (mi sono svegliato), travel words at the station, the airport and the hotel, and telling the story of a trip or of your arrival in Italy.
description:
Part of the official SS Europa Italian course used in our classes, for learners from India, Pakistan and Bangladesh who are going to Italy to work, study or live. Chapters 1–7 take you from zero to level A1 and Chapters 8–12 to level A2 — study them in order.

Every 60-minute class of the chapter is split into three short lessons you can study on your phone, with pictures, audio, grammar tables and exercises. Every word comes with its English and Punjabi meaning, the slides of each class are attached as PDF, and the chapter ends with a test (pass mark 60%).
objectives:
I can use the passato prossimo with essere and make the participle agree: è andato, è andata, sono andati
I can choose avere or essere: che cosa? → avere · dove? → essere
I can use reflexive verbs in the past: mi sono svegliato / svegliata
I can buy a train ticket and ask for the platform
I can check in at a hotel and ask for a single or double room
I can tell the story of a trip or of my arrival in Italy

lessons.summary: Read Kamal's arrival story and a Sunday trip to Verona — then end your story well.

blocks.title: Il mio arrivo in Italia
blocks.body:
Mi chiamo Kamal e sono nato in India. Sono arrivato in Italia tre anni fa, nel mese di ottobre.

Prima sono partito da Nuova Delhi in aereo e sono atterrato a Milano Malpensa. Poi mio fratello è venuto a prendermi in macchina e siamo andati a Mantova.

All'inizio sono stato un po' timido per la lingua, ma oggi ho imparato l'italiano e mi sono integrato bene!
blocks.caption:
My name is Kamal and I was born in India. I arrived in Italy three years ago, in October.

First I left New Delhi by plane and landed at Milano Malpensa. Then my brother came to pick me up by car and we went to Mantova.

At first I was a bit shy because of the language, but today I have learnt Italian and I have settled in well!

blocks.title: La nostra domenica a Verona
blocks.body:
Domenica scorsa io e mia moglie ci siamo svegliati presto e siamo andati in stazione.

Abbiamo comprato due biglietti di andata e ritorno e siamo partiti alle nove. Siamo arrivati a Verona dopo quaranta minuti.

Abbiamo visitato Piazza Bra, abbiamo fatto tante foto e siamo tornati a casa alle sette di sera. Ci siamo divertiti tantissimo!
blocks.caption:
Last Sunday my wife and I woke up early and went to the station.

We bought two return tickets and left at nine. We arrived in Verona after forty minutes.

We visited Piazza Bra, took lots of photos and came back home at seven in the evening. We had a great time!

blocks.title: Ripasso lampo
blocks.body:
- **ESSERE** with movement / change: andare, venire, partire, arrivare, tornare, entrare, uscire, stare, rimanere, nascere
- **Agreement:** -o · -a · -i · -e
- **Test:** che cosa? → avere · dove? → essere
- **Reflexives:** always essere (mi sono svegliato/a)
- **Travel:** biglietteria, binario, andata e ritorno, ritardo, valigia, prenotazione, camera singola / doppia

lessons.title: Chapter 9 test
lessons.summary: Listening, travel words, essere and agreement, avere or essere, reflexives in the past. Pass mark: 60%.

blocks.title: Test Capitolo 9
blocks.body:
This test checks everything in Chapter 9 (Lessons 1–4).

- **1. Listening** — sentences and a travel story
- **2. Vocabulary** — station, airport and hotel
- **3. Grammar** — essere with agreement, avere or essere, reflexive verbs in the past
- **4. Writing** — your arrival in Italy or a trip

You need **60%** to pass. You can repeat the test as many times as you like.
